Open World Memory Map

Where every byte of the C64's 64K goes in each mode of the smooth-scrolling open world, read from the linker maps of the build named below (tools/mkmemmap.py, which make runs). Rows are address ranges; a block spans the rows it covers. Hatched blocks are free. Hover a block to light up the same block in every mode it appears in: gold blocks are the ones that survive every program load.
